Runtime ID of the tool the request is for; `null` for the base

child.

short_id.description:
Short, tree-unique model-facing handle (`<agent_type>_<8 hex>`).
Optional and additive: sessions created before handles existed carry
no value and resolve by full UUID only.

oneOf.description: The session was attached to a runtime instance under `name`.

kind.description: Runtime kind the runtime declares, such as `coding` or `global`.

workspace.description: Canonical workspace the runtime reported; absent without one.

oneOf.description: The attachment `name` was removed from the session.

attachment.description:
The coding-runtime attachment whose workspace the files came
from.

oneOf.description:
A notice about the engine, a plugin, or a runtime: something it
turned off, could not do, or dropped. `detail` is display-only.

count.description: How many occurrences this one record coalesces; absent for one.

kind.description: What a diagnostic reports, as a snake-case label.

source.description: Who a diagnostic is about: `engine:<area>`, `plugin:<name>`, or `runtime:<id>`.

oneOf.description:
Sole durable message body and per-send delivery mode. Acceptance is valid
during an active run without creating a runless UserInputAdmitted.

agent_hop.description:
Internal `send_message` guard metadata: position of this message in
its agent-mail chain (`0` for mail sent by a run that has seen no
agent mail). Never rendered into the agent-visible envelope and
never compared for idempotency. Absent on non-Agent producers and on
mail accepted before hop counting existed.

idempotency_key.description: Sender-chosen idempotency key scoped to a session and stable producer owner.

retained_output.description:
Engine-retained output the body points the agent at (a background
job's full stdout/stderr). Recording it here keeps the artifacts
alive for later reads; plugins cannot supply it.

oneOf.description:
Run-scoped reference, not a second body or consumption marker. Its event
sequence participates in ModelTurnCommitted.input_through_seq coverage.

Run-scoped reservation of pending admitted messages. The envelope
sequence is the claim token, not proof that provider dispatch occurred.
Releases the claim identified by a ProducerMessagesClaimed envelope.

Append only after committed model input coverage includes the admission.
Recovery repairs missing markers from that commit, never from API selection.

Pending messages may be discarded by stable owner identity. Historical
goal reminder discards omitted producer_owner and remain readable.

Input waiting for the running run to complete. The run the engine
then starts with it carries `client_run_id`; a failed, cancelled, or
interrupted run voids every queued input instead.
Its author withdrew the queued input at `queued_seq`.

The engine voided every queued input without starting a run, for
example because the queued run could not start.

A client picked the session's model selection: later runs use it
unless a request names its own, and every client's draft follows it.
The run ended.

Names of the tools sent with this attempt's request, after plugin
rewrites. Recorded only when they differ from the session's previous
record.

The attempt began streaming a text or reasoning part: its first
output, or a switch between the two. The deltas themselves are
live-only; this durably records where in the log, and when, each
streamed part began.
Live-only: delivered as a [`TransientEvent`], never persisted.
Live-only: delivered as a [`TransientEvent`], never persisted.

Live-only: text an internal agent is streaming, delivered as a
[`TransientEvent`] and never persisted. Its terminal internal-agent
event is the durable record.

Live-only: a provider-native compaction call began, delivered as a

Live-only: the provider-native compaction call returned, whether or

model_error.description:
The model error that ended the attempt (retry, fallback, or
recovery trigger).

base_attempt_id.description:
An earlier attempt of the same run, with the same resolved model,
whose full decision list this attempt's list extends. Absent means
`ordered_decisions` is the full list.

ordered_decisions.description:
The attempt's replay decisions. With `base_attempt_id`, only the
decisions appended after that attempt's list, which is an exact
prefix of this one.

background.description:
Whether the call's tool supports the background, so a client may
offer to move the call there.

oneOf.description: Live-only: delivered as a [`TransientEvent`], never persisted.

cache_strategies.description: One cache strategy per entry of the child's selected suffix.

oneOf.description: A delegation reached a new stage before it finished.

A delegation finished. It is the durable control record and carries
the teaser transcripts render: `short_id` is the child's handle, and
`preview` the report as `[subagent_output]` previews it.

GoalReminderIdentity.description:
Pending reminder metadata, NOT a durable send idempotency key.
Coalescing uses the goal ID and revision, independently of the presentation kind.
After consumption another continuation at the same revision uses a fresh send.

GoalReminderKind.description: Whether a reminder introduces the objective or continues previously consumed work.

InternalAgentOutcome.description:
How an internal agent invocation ended: the `outcome` of
[`EventPayload::InternalAgentFinished`].

Open: an outcome this build does not know reads as interrupted, with no
result.

resource.description: Current wildcard grammar: '*' matches any characters, '?' matches one character, and the exact '${workspace_dir}' expression is allowed; controls, globstar, escapes, classes, and every other brace form are forbidden. Runtime deserialization additionally enforces a maximum of 4096 UTF-8 bytes; x-cookie-agent-maxUtf8Bytes records that byte limit because JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points.

runtime.description: The rule's runtime selector, when it has one.

response_body.description: Bounded diagnostic text permitting newlines and tabs.

action.description: Permission action a tool declares, such as `read`, `bash`, or a runtime's own action.

resource.description: Current wildcard grammar: '*' matches any characters, '?' matches one character, and the exact '${workspace_dir}' expression is allowed; controls, globstar, escapes, classes, and every other brace form are forbidden. Runtime deserialization additionally enforces a maximum of 4096 UTF-8 bytes; x-cookie-agent-maxUtf8Bytes records that byte limit because JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points.

runtime.description:
Runtime selector (`bash@labpc`): the rule applies only to tools of
runtimes with this runtime ID. Absent, it applies everywhere,
including the base layer.

PersistedModelBinding.description:
A frozen model binding as session history stores it: the identity a
reader needs to attribute and validate records, and the complete binding
as an opaque value.

`frozen` is today's [`FrozenModelBinding`] (descriptor, request defaults,
provider options, credential and setup bindings, static headers). Nothing
decodes it when a log loads; [`Self::decode`] does, best-effort, only
where the engine runs the binding again.

adapter.description:
The protocol adapter the binding speaks, such as
`oven.openai.responses`.

frozen.description: The complete binding, opaque to readers.

resolved.description: The model reference attempts made with this binding record.

selection.description: One exact base or named-variant model selection.

PersistedToolResult.description:
A tool result as sessions store it and clients receive it. When `display`
occurs verbatim in `output`, which is the common case (a single-output tool
shows its output, a shell its only stream), it is written as the byte range
`display_span` into `output` instead of a second copy.

additional_messages.description: Emitted model-history messages. Their files share the 256-file limit with attachments.

attachments.description: Direct result files. Together with files in additional_messages, at most 256 are allowed.

display_span.description: Byte range [start, end) of `output` that is the display text. Present instead of `display` when the display occurs verbatim in `output`.

capability.description: Permission action a tool declares, such as `read`, `bash`, or a runtime's own action.

ProducerDeliveryMode.description:
Per-send mode. Queue remains accepted-but-deferred during an active run;
steer joins the next safe request without interrupting an in-flight request.

ProducerOwner.description:
Stable identity used with session + idempotency key for durable deduplication.
External identifies a producer outside the daemon, a plugin or a runtime:
the engine derives `source` from the authenticated connection, never from
send parameters, and the sender chooses `name` when it registers. The
connection epoch that authorizes live sends is runtime-only and never part
of this durable owner or the deduplication key.
GoalControl identifies engine-authored lifecycle steering, not a continuation
reminder; its accepted messages survive goal-controller teardown.
Agent identifies an in-tree agent mail sender; the session identity is
engine-derived from the executing tool context, never from model arguments.
Tool identifies the background result of one tool call that ran in the
background; the call identity is engine-derived from the executing tool
context, never from model arguments.
Subagent identifies a delegated session reporting its finished turns to
its parent.
The owner is durable and participates in `(session, owner, key)` dedup.

oneOf.description: A plugin's or a runtime's named producer.

name.description: A producer's label, chosen by its sender at registration.

source.description: Who produces from outside the daemon: `plugin:<name>` or `runtime:<attachment name>`.

oneOf.description: A delegated session reporting a finished turn to its parent.

expected.description: One exact base or named-variant model selection.

found.description: One exact base or named-variant model selection.

adapter_id.description: Wire adapter a model is reached through, such as `anthropic` or `openai-responses`.

selection.description: One exact base or named-variant model selection.

reference.description:
The one stream's artifact, or the named-stream manifest. Absent when
every stream fit inline.

dropped_bytes.description:
Bytes past the capture limit that the artifact does not hold: it keeps
the stream's head up to the limit and its last stretch, with a marker
line between them.

reference.description:
The stream's full content. Absent, with `sha256`, when the stream fit
its preview and the result output already holds all of it.

RunOutcome.description:
How a run ended: the `outcome` of [`EventPayload::RunFinished`].

Open: an outcome this build does not know reads as interrupted, a run
that ended without this build being able to say how.

model.description: One exact base or named-variant model selection.

attachment.description:
The attachment that contributed a project skill; its grants apply
only to that attachment's tools. Absent for a user skill.

StreamedOutputKind.description: The kind of part a model attempt streams.

primary_argument.description: Bounded presentation text; byte-capped only, clients sanitize control characters.

runtime_id.description: Runtime ID the grant applies to; `null` for base-layer tools.

description:
One record of a session log.

The envelope's `skippable` is not a field: it is derived from the
payload's class ([`EventPayload::is_audit`]), written only when true, and
checked against the payload when read.

skippable.description: Present and true exactly on audit events: a reader that does not know the payload's type may skip the record.
